name: silverback
description: The shared AGENTS.md ruleset for Codex: boundaries, security, a verification gate before any completion claim, concise communication and commit conventions, loaded at session start, with hooks that block force-pushes, discarded work, skipped git hooks and environment dumps, and deny a push, a recursive delete, a history rewrite or an edit to agent instruction files until the user turns that check off.
